(2) The camera pans and cuts as the girl hugs the plush goose tightly to her chest while walking across a wooden floor towards a person wearing blue jeans. Sunlight illuminates the scene from a large window in the background. (3) The girl stands next to a man sitting on a play mat; he is wearing glasses and a yellow shirt. He uses small mallets to play a set of colorful toy drums. The girl watches him with a neutral, slightly confused expression, then looks away towards the plush goose. (4) The girl turns her back to the drums and reaches for the large plush goose held by an adult off-screen. She hugs it joyfully, closing her eyes and smiling broadly with pure delight. The scene cuts to a pink graphic background with a cartoon illustration.
